title: Token pipeline sentinel + lifecycle probes for Private deployments
creator: Aisha Thompson
description: Add a suite of lifecycle-aware probes and a token-pipeline sentinel for Private (VPC) deployments that detect latency regressions, error-rate spikes, saturation of GPU workers, and token throughput degradation. Deliverables include: probe definitions, Terraform module hooks to deploy probe configs into customer VPCs, alert thresholds and runbook, canary upgrade gating using probe signals, and dashboards for on-call teams.
acceptance_criteria: Probe set deployed via terraform module and configurable per-customer (threshold overrides)
Latency probes report p50/p95/p99 and trigger alerts when p95 increases >25% over baseline or p99 > defined SLO
Error-rate probes aggregate 1m and 5m windows; alert if 5m error rate > 0.5% or sudden 10x spike from baseline
Saturation probe measures GPU queue depth and CPU/RAM pressure; alert if queue depth sustained > configured threshold for 3 minutes
Token throughput sentinel monitors tokens/sec per model-worker pool and triggers throttling recommendations or fallback routing when sustained drop >20% versus expected capacity
Canary upgrade playbook uses probe signals to auto-halt rollout and roll back when critical SLO breaches detected
End-to-end test harness (synthetic workloads) validates probe behavior against injected faults
Documentation and runbook (Confluence) linked from terraform module README, including required IAM and networking permissions
tasks: Define probe metrics and proto payloads for agent -> control-plane telemetry (owner: Liam)
Extend terraform private module to accept probe_config and lifecycle hooks (owner: Infra-IaC team)
Implement sentinel service to compute rolling token throughput and saturation heuristics (owner: Marco Ruiz)
Build synthetic probe generator for private clusters (k8s job) and add to test harness (owner: Sofia Patel)
Create dashboards and alerting rules in Grafana/Alertmanager with SLO labels (owner: Observability)
Write canary upgrade gating logic in the deployment controller to consume probe signals (owner: Liam)
Author runbook with mitigation steps and escalation path; include rollback playbook snippets (owner: Aisha)
comments: 2025-02-18 - Aisha Thompson: Kickoff - initial scope agreed with PM. Focus on four probe families: latency, error-rate, saturation, token-throughput. Decided terraform integration is mandatory for private customers.
